name: codex-orchestration
description: Credit-saving Codex routing with bounded handoffs, checks, and savings receipts.

interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration for the current chat with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. It reads one consolidated routing contract, scores every deliverable once, hands executive ownership below 5.0 to GPT-5.6 Terra / High, and retains primary GPT-5.6 Sol / High ownership at 5.0 and above. Simple conversational or bounded tool work below 5.0 gets one immediate Sol-to-Terra handoff and Terra completes it directly; substantive implementation uses the fixed cheaper model ladder: Luna / Max at 1.0–2.9, Terra / Medium at 3.0–5.0, Terra / High at 5.1–6.5, Sol / Low at 6.6–7.2, Sol / Medium at 7.3–7.9, and Sol / High at 8.0–10.0. Normal routing skips reference reads, installer checks, runtime inspection, receipt startup, and manual thread registration. Each producer self-checks; the owning executive checks once, gives at most one correction request, then takes over if correction fails. The finish-time receipt discovers actual descendants from the task transcript, compares the routed model mix with all-Sol pricing, and falls back to official-rate task credits when weekly calibration is unavailable. Daily upstream review never merges automatically and stays off the user's critical path. Accepted fork changes finish on jessejaffe/codex-orchestration main.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” to save credits with one bounded implementation handoff and acceptance loop.
